text:
Alex M: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for last night's TLS failures. Root cause looks like an SNI mismatch between our edge LB and backend in a cross-region path which triggered retries and higher tail latency in eu-west/us-west. Postmortem is published: https://intra.redwood/postmortems/sni-2026-03-22 . Need owners on remediation items and clear timelines.

Maria G: I'll take the LB config remediation — ensure SNI header preservation on proxy->backend and fix the old nginx header-stripping rule. ETA: canary by EOD Wed, full rollout after canary looks good. Will open PR shortly.

Chen L: I'll run a region-by-region DNS/target-group audit (CNAMEs, ALB target groups, and recorder of old naming). Will produce a checklist and initial findings by tomorrow noon.

Sam R: I'll own the infra-ci tests: add an e2e that simulates SNI mismatch and fails the build if any region returns TLS alert or 5xx. Need access to staging certs to implement. ETA: next Tue for test + gating.

Priya K: I'll draft the runbook updates (detection, mitigation, rollback steps, alerts) and coordinate comms to CS. Will pair with Sam for the test verification steps.

incident-bot: Postmortem published: https://intra.redwood/postmortems/sni-2026-03-22 :page_facing_up: (auto)

Alex M: Assigning owners in the tracker now: Maria (LB config) | Chen (DNS audit) | Sam (tests/CI) | Priya (runbook/comm). Please add PR/ticket links and ETAs to the postmortem and our action tracker.

Maria G: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/+/2345 — includes canary plan and nginx config diff. Note: reproduction local shows header drop only when upstream is old proxy version.

Chen L: Found 2 edge clusters still using legacy target-group names; will open tickets to reconcile and propose a periodic verification job to avoid drift.

Sam R: Can someone attach a failing request capture/log from last night? Need the TLS alert string and example headers to build the test. @Alex M

Alex M: Attached snippet from last night logs: `curl -v --resolve example.internal:443:10.1.2.3 https://example.internal/` -> TLS alert: 'unrecognized_name' from backend. Full logs uploaded to #incidents-archive/link: https://files.redwood/archives/sni-fail.log

Priya K: I'll schedule a 30-min cross-team sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to validate rollout plan and check gating criteria. Who can join? @Maria G @Chen L @Sam R

Maria G: :thumbsup: I'll be there.

Chen L: In.

Sam R: In, I'll prep the CI test checklist.

Alex M: Recurrence note: monitoring shows 3 similar SNI-related incidents in the last 90 days, all around cross-region failovers. Action: create a recurring-incident pattern ticket and surface it in the weekly reliability review so this isn't treated as one-off.

Maria G: Will add the recurrence ticket and propose a config flag to force SNI preservation at the edge as a short-term mitigation.

Chen L: Timeline recap: LB fix canary Wed EOD, DNS audit Thu, CI tests next Tue, runbook + comms by end of the week. If anyone needs to adjust ETA update the tracker.

Sam R: I'll add the CI job + a canary gating step so we don't roll without the SNI test passing. Also will add a smoke test for cross-region failovers.

Priya K: I'll own stakeholder comms — short note to CS and infra after canary results.

Alex M: Thanks — I'll update the postmortem with owners/timelines after tomorrow's sync. @ops-bot please create the consolidated ticket for tracking owners and timeline.

ops-bot: Created ticket PROJECT-2891 "SNI mismatch remediation — owners, timeline, and recurrence tracking" assigned to Alex M.

Alex M: Closing notes: please update the ticket with PR links, test CI IDs, and canary metrics (error rate, p50/p95 latency) after each change. We'll review progress in next week's reliability review. Thanks everyone.
